description: Permissions granted to the Nox window. Deliberately minimal: core, the deep-link listener used to receive nox://auth-callback, and opening the Supabase OAuth consent URL in the real browser.

permissions.description: Only the Supabase auth host. The single URL the app ever opens externally is the OAuth consent URL that signInWithOAuth returns, which lives there — so anything else asking to launch a browser is a bug or an injection, and is denied.
